name: plan/server-probe
history/run-sql
backup/table-count
text:
docker exec -i shipkit-probe-db psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U postgres -d probe -tA <<'SHIPKIT_SQL'
select count(*) from pg_catalog.pg_class c join pg_catalog.pg_namespace n on n.oid = c.relnamespace where c.relkind in ('r', 'p') and n.nspname <> 'information_schema' and n.nspname !~ '^pg_'
SHIPKIT_SQL

name: backup/pg-dump
text: docker exec shipkit-probe-db pg_dump -Fc -U postgres probe

name: backup/listing
text:
[ -d /var/backups/shipkit/shipkit-probe ] || { echo SHIPKIT_BACKUPS_NONE; exit 0; }
cd /var/backups/shipkit/shipkit-probe || exit 3
for f in *.pgc; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; stat -c '%Y %s %n' "$f" || exit 3; done
echo SHIPKIT_BACKUPS_END

name: backup/scp-dump
text:
set -e
local_sum=$(sha256sum /backup/dump.pgc | cut -d' ' -f1)
echo dW1hc2sgMDc3ICYmIG1rZGlyIC1wIC92YXIvYmFja3Vwcy9zaGlwa2l0L3NoaXBraXQtcHJvYmUgJiYgdGVzdCAtdyAvdmFyL2JhY2t1cHMvc2hpcGtpdC9zaGlwa2l0LXByb2Jl | base64 -d | ssh -i /root/.ssh/id_ed25519 -p 22 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=/root/.ssh/known_hosts -o GlobalKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o BatchMode=yes deploy@173.242.58.240 sh
scp -O -i /root/.ssh/id_ed25519 -P 22 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=/root/.ssh/known_hosts -o GlobalKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o BatchMode=yes /backup/dump.pgc deploy@173.242.58.240:/var/backups/shipkit/shipkit-probe/.sha0123-20260922T100000Z.pgc.partial
remote_sum=$(echo c2hhMjU2c3VtIC92YXIvYmFja3Vwcy9zaGlwa2l0L3NoaXBraXQtcHJvYmUvLnNoYTAxMjMtMjAyNjA5MjJUMTAwMDAwWi5wZ2MucGFydGlhbA== | base64 -d | ssh -i /root/.ssh/id_ed25519 -p 22 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=/root/.ssh/known_hosts -o GlobalKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o BatchMode=yes deploy@173.242.58.240 sh | cut -d' ' -f1)
if [ -z "$local_sum" ] || [ "$remote_sum" != "$local_sum" ]; then echo "sha256 differs after upload: local $local_sum, server ${remote_sum:-none}" >&2; exit 1; fi
echo  | base64 -d | ssh -i /root/.ssh/id_ed25519 -p 22 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=/root/.ssh/known_hosts -o GlobalKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o BatchMode=yes deploy@173.242.58.240 sh
echo "$local_sum"

name: migrate/run-bundle
text: { printf 'SHIPKIT_DSN_B64=%s\n' "$(printf '%s' "$SHIPKIT_DB_URL" | base64 | tr -d '\n')"; echo  | base64 -d; } | ssh -i /root/.ssh/id_ed25519 -p 22 -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes -o UserKnownHostsFile=/root/.ssh/known_hosts -o GlobalKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o BatchMode=yes deploy@173.242.58.240 sh

name: release/container-versions
text:
echo containers:begin
docker ps -a --filter 'label=service=shipkit-probe' --format '{{.Names}}'
echo containers:end

name: lock/acquire
text:
mkdir -p "$HOME/.shipkit"
if mkdir "$HOME/.shipkit/deploy-lock-shipkit-probe" 2>/dev/null; then
  printf 'id=%s\nsha=%s\nenv=%s\nactor=%s\nserver_user=%s\nsince=%s\n' 'abc123' 'sha-0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567' 'test' 'ci-key-probe' "$(id -un)" "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" > "$HOME/.shipkit/deploy-lock-shipkit-probe/holder" || { rm -rf "$HOME/.shipkit/deploy-lock-shipkit-probe"; exit 1; }
  echo ACQUIRED
else
  echo HELD
  cat "$HOME/.shipkit/deploy-lock-shipkit-probe/holder" 2>/dev/null || echo "holder=unknown (no holder file)"
fi

name: lock/release
text:
if grep -qx 'id=abc123' "$HOME/.shipkit/deploy-lock-shipkit-probe/holder" 2>/dev/null; then
  rm -rf "$HOME/.shipkit/deploy-lock-shipkit-probe" && echo RELEASED
else
  echo NOT-OURS
fi

name: db/wait-for-database
text: i=0; while [ $i -lt 90 ]; do docker exec shipkit-probe-db pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U postgres -d probe >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; i=$((i+1)); sleep 1; done; exit 1
